headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalCorrectedWordLaw_eq_bind
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  (start : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L) (h k : ℕ),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalCorrectedWordLaw r c U L hr hc start h k =
    OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.bindLaw
      (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.mapLaw OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw
        (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalScheduleWord r c U L hr hc start h))
      (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalFiniteCorrectionRow r c U L k)

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalCorrectedWord_accuracy
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  [inst : Nonempty (Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L)],
  ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j →
    2 ≤ U →
      7 ≤ L →
        2 ≤
            Fintype.card
              (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
                (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U)) →
          ∀ (start : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L) (h k : ℕ),
            OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation
                (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalCorrectedWordLaw r c U L hr hc start h k)
                (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalIdealCorrectedLaw r c U L) ≤
              Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic h + Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic k
